title: Throttle high-frequency logs and deduplicate validation output
purpose: Reduce console spam that may mask critical signals and contribute to apparent freezes while debugging.

steps.detail: Throttle recurring logs (descriptor pushes, bounds overlay, status blocks) to every N frames with clear tags.
Add a simple in-process filter to suppress identical validation messages after K repeats per run; log once with a '(suppressed N)' note.
Introduce INFO/DEBUG/WARN channels and use WARN for validation and critical runtime state; gate DEBUG by a flag.

acceptance: Run log remains readable under validation spam
Key events (TLAS ready, descriptor push counts) still visible
notes: Keep logs minimal in hot paths; prefer periodic summaries.
